zh.title: Textron以12億美元出售工業部門
zh.summary: Textron確認以12億美元出售工業業務，預計2027上半年完成。
body: Textron已於2026年11月18日簽署最終協議，將以12億美元出售其工業部門。
被出售的業務包括Kautex、Textron Specialized Vehicles等，買方為Kingswood Capital Management附屬公司，交易預計於2027上半年完成，仍須取得監管批准。
完成後公司將更名為New Textron，屆時僅保留Cessna、Beechcraft、Bell直升機及Textron Systems的航空防務產品。

en.title: Textron to sell industrial segment for $1.2B
en.summary: Textron agrees to sell its industrial segment for $1.2 billion, closing expected in early 2027.
body: Textron announced on November 18, 2026 that it has entered a definitive agreement to sell its industrial segment for $1.2 billion.

The assets to be divested include Kautex and Textron Specialized Vehicles, and the buyer is an affiliate of Kingswood Capital Management. The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approval.
After completion, the company will be renamed New Textron and will retain the Cessna and Beechcraft brands, Bell’s rotorcraft lines and the aerospace and defence products of Textron Systems.
